scenes.text: *Three AI agents* a one-person business can run for *under $20 a month each*

scenes.title: Agent 1: the *competitor watch*
lines: Perplexity Computer Automations (Pro, $20). 'Every Monday 7am: check these five competitor sites, list price and product changes, email me.'
Fathom AI runs theirs every two hours.

scenes.title: Agent 2: the *inbox sorter*
lines: Gemini tasks mode (AI Pro, $19.99). 'Each morning: sort new email into Leads, Invoices, Noise. Draft replies to the leads. Wait for my OK.'
Claude Duet (Oct 21) does the same across your work apps.

scenes.title: Agent 3: the *bookkeeper*
lines: Claude in Google Sheets (Pro, $20). 'Each month: pull the new rows, flag anything unusual, update the summary tab.'
You read the summary. It does the rows.

scenes.title: The *rule*
lines: One agent per job. Each one pauses for your approval before anything sends or gets paid.
Fathom's twelve agents started as one.

scenes.title: The *math*
lines: Three agents, about $60 a month. One saved hour a day is 20 hours a month.
Charge clients for the hours. Keep the agents.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: Agents break when a website changes its layout. Spot-check weekly.
Sources: Fortune, Apr 18; Perplexity changelog, Oct; Google, Oct 13; Anthropic, Oct 6, 2026.

scenes.text: Which agent would you set up *first*: watch, inbox or books? Comment it.
